blocks.text: «Verbs which have in the infinitive a consonant before **-ть** (**-ти**) or end with **-чь** have the past tense as follows: **есть** — **ел**, **ела**, **ело**, **ели**; **идти** — **шёл**, **шла**, **шло**, **шли**; (**мочь**) — **мог**, **могла**, **могло**, **могли**.»

From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 42, p. 112. · Every form in the tables on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own, generated by tools/courses/gen_tables.py. OpenCorpora, CC BY-SA 4.0.
